lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate's nix manager refreshes a branch- or tag-tracking input only through a whole-lock `nix flake update` (per-input PRs need a rev pinned in flake.nix). The private site inputs are fetched through the git insteadOf rules in .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Automerge waits for the test-server status from .github/workflows/renovate.yml; platformAutomerge is off because GitHub's own auto-merge, with no required checks, would merge straight away.
prBodyNotes: This is `nix flake update` of every input, the site repos included, so their Caddy configs ship with it. The Renovate workflow tests it (server VM test, laptop evaluation) and reports `test-server` on this commit; Renovate merges it on a later run once that is green, and the nightly auto-upgrade deploys it. A failed test leaves the PR open.
